description: §7.6 (S478; code name confirmed S479) — a file-scope `const` whose initializer runs a `?{}` query is E-FILE-SCOPE-SERVER-ONLY-REACH: module initialization is synchronous and cannot wait on the server.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S478 "⭐ RULED — open owner questions, PA recs adopted wholesale" item 59 (a) · ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — S478 hand-off §3.A and §3.B, PA recs adopted" item 2 (code name confirmed)
rationale: §7.6: "An initializer that reaches a server-only resource — a `?{}` query (§8) … — SHALL be a compile error, **`E-FILE-SCOPE-SERVER-ONLY-REACH`**".
